content_blocks.title: Apply the idea
content_blocks.text: Apply Sorting Results with ORDER BY to a synthetic MySQL lab scenario, write down the expected outcome, and specify how you will verify it safely. Write down the expected result before running the snippet. Compare actual output with the reference, then try one normal case and one edge case.

content_blocks.code:
SELECT item, price FROM (
  SELECT 'Notebook' AS item, 45.00 AS price
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Lamp', 250.00
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Pen', 15.00
) AS products
WHERE price < 100
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 2;
content_blocks.expected_output: Two rows: Notebook (45.00) and Pen (15.00), in descending price order.
